_comment: The Linux client's OWN sentences: the ones neither the apps' Localizable.xcstrings nor the
Windows port's win/i18n/win.json holds (shell-design §23). The shape is win.json's. Every
sentence comes with its eight translations in the same change (W.1 'Strings'); an EMPTY object
would mean 'English for now' and must then also be on ENGLISH_FOR_NOW in
crates/fc-core/tests/text_catalogue.rs. 'Top bar' is GNOME's term for the bar at the top of the
screen (the Mac's menu bar). linux/i18n/generate.py turns this file, the xcstrings and win.json
into linux/data/i18n/*.json; its --check is the CI string gate.
